verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a SaaS identity-verification dashboard could plausibly offer AI-generated insights. However, the evidence only documents risk scores, the largest contributing risk factors, and conversion reporting in the Dashboard. None of it is described as AI-generated insights or suggestions. The MCP server listing belongs to a separate server-integration story and does not establish in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
